reddit.title: Improved Performance in Flowing Water Simulation
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to our flowing water mechanics in Provincia! By optimizing how we handle drying cells, we've reduced the script time for a 64×64 lake from about 20 ms to just 12 ms. This means a smoother gameplay experience without sacrificing visual fidelity. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Flowing Water Performance Update
steam.body: We're excited to announce a performance update for flowing water in Provincia! Thanks to recent optimizations, drying cells now only affect their immediate neighbors, resulting in a significant reduction in processing time. This change will lead to a smoother gameplay experience. For more details, check out our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
